redactionPolicy.item: Local-root, multi-segment absolute, UNC, drive-letter, tilde, $HOME, percent-encoded and file-URL path tokens
redactionPolicy.effect: Replaced whole, including in additive fields, free text, URL paths and key=value forms; identity and digest fields refuse publication instead. Single-segment tokens and API routes such as /v1 are left alone
UUID-shaped identifiers are replaced globally in string values and dropped by key wherever they appear

Recognised credential shapes (token prefixes, authorization headers, key=value secrets, PEM private keys, JWTs) are replaced globally; this is a pattern check, not a guarantee that every private string is caught. Inspect the bundle before sharing
Nonempty blocks are replaced by an omission marker; plan identity and request identifiers stay private
Session ids, executable paths and argument vectors are removed; harness versions, packet and score hashes are retained
Retained from the input dataset as judge provenance, not generated by the exporter. Other dated material can also remain in supplied inputs

The live username, home directory, hostname and an optional build-time deny list are checked when the bundle is built; a configured deny file that cannot be read refuses the build rather than silently emptying the list. Verification applies host-independent patterns only, including recognised URL patterns for private, loopback and tailnet hosts

omitted: Private account and quota headers (nonempty subscriptionQuota blocks are replaced by an omission marker)
Judge session identifiers, judge executable paths and launch arguments
Private run artefact locations: digests are retained in provenance.json
Private raw sessions, request captures, workspace snapshots and replay fixtures
Corpus: supplied through the inputs manifest, hash-bound to the dataset's frozen corpusSha256
Protocol document: supplied through the inputs manifest
Design manifest: supplied through the inputs manifest
Environment metadata attachment: not supplied through the inputs manifest
Additional attachments: an other-role input was supplied; inspect inputs/manifest.json
Full final answers: supplied as an attachment; judge passages in dataset.json may have been sanitised and do not substitute for them
Main-model identity: declared in the inputs manifest (not verified against run data)

Calibration visibility: admitted through revision-binding-valid using corpus-revision-binding.json (sha256 cbb917ecda8a7c6f2e0578341e4b9c1592e90536b9d9ad8b569cd2eb3e1b19ca). The binding records a blob-level comparison showing unchanged rubric and in-scope task material and cites the owner-approved carry-over. It does not establish judge reliability or answer-quality preservation
Context-exposure incomplete records: totals are withheld and only recorded observed lower bounds are published for those runs
effect: The bundle regenerates the numerical analysis, claim states, completeness summaries and supplied quality-score records from dataset.json and, for input-dependent disclosures and environment fields, inputs/manifest.json when present, without model calls. It does not independently verify the observations against private requests, source-backed judging packets or captured pages. Sanitisation can leave redaction markers in settings and judge text; recorded scrub locations and aggregate dropped-key counts are in provenance.json. This record is a policy and omission list, not a field-by-field audit. Inspect the bundle before sharing.
